title.zh: How Tether’s $45 million crackdown drove Southeast Asian scam compounds into an ‘unfreezable’ decentralized stablecoin
title.en: How Tether’s $45 million crackdown drove Southeast Asian scam compounds into an ‘unfreezable’ decentralized stablecoin

current_state.zh: Tether froze over $45 million in USDT across Xinbi-linked wallets, prompting the sanctioned marketplace to move to the decentralized stablecoin USDD, which lacks address-level blacklisting.
